name: @w6w-apps/ahrefs
description: Query Ahrefs SEO data — domain rating, backlinks, referring domains, organic keywords, top pages, keyword research, SERP overview, Rank Tracker and Site Audit — and check API unit usage.

w6w.longDescription:
Ahrefs is an SEO and search-intelligence platform. This app connects a workflow to its v3 REST API with an API key, so a flow can pull the same data the Ahrefs reports show: a domain's Domain Rating and its history, backlink and referring-domain profiles, anchor text, broken backlinks, organic keywords, top pages and organic competitors, plus search volume, difficulty and traffic potential for keywords, the live SERP for a keyword, Rank Tracker positions and Site Audit health scores and issues.

Every data call is a GET that takes a `select` list of columns, an optional `where` filter and `order_by`, and a `limit`. Ahrefs bills each request in API units (a 50-unit minimum, more per returned column and row), so each action returns the units the call actually cost, and a Limits and usage action reads the key's monthly allowance and spend without consuming any. Free test targets (ahrefs.com, yep.com, firehose.com) cost nothing.

Ahrefs answers a bad key with HTTP 401 and a missing one with 403, both as a bare JSON array; this app reads the body rather than the status. Health checks verify the key against the free limits-and-usage call, whether the API answers, and the remaining unit headroom.
